subject: Next steps: hosted evaluation — sandbox access and rate-profile request
messages:
From: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@clearcredit.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Quick demo recap + hosted evaluation asks

Thanks again for the demo earlier, Rajiv — good discussion. Quick recap and a few asks so we can get your hosted pilot stood up this week:

- Preference: you mentioned leaning toward Hosted API for speed of iteration (vs Dedicated/Private) unless we hit a steady-state throughput or data residency requirement. Please confirm if Hosted is acceptable for the initial pilot.
- Traffic profile: can you confirm target peak QPS and typical concurrent users for the 2-week pilot? Also helpful: average prompt length (tokens) and expected responses per request.
- Rate controls: we can set per-endpoint ratecaps, per-key token quotas, and concurrency ceilings. Tell us the top 2 routes you expect to exercise (e.g., /v1/chat, /v1/embeddings) and a rough RPS for each.
- Data concerns: any PII/exclusion rules or retention constraints we should know about for the pilot?
- Quickstart access: we can provision sandbox endpoints + 200k token trial credits and sample ratecaps for pilot. Want us to provision that to rajiv@clearcredit.io?

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm: Hosted pilot OK + the traffic numbers above (by end of day Monday).
2) We provision sandbox credentials and attach the quickstart-playbook (lightweight guide + checklist).
3) Run 2-week pilot. We’ll provide per-route dashboards and a simple cost estimate based on observed token burn.

If Hosted isn’t acceptable for any reason (regulatory, data residency), tell us and we’ll scope Dedicated or Private options with an ops-runbook.

Attaching: Redwood quickstart-playbook (summary), and a sample traffic template you can fill in.

Thanks — I’ll block a 30-min follow-up next Thursday to review pilot results and any procurement questions.

— Kim Park
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference

Attachments: quickstart-playbook.pdf (pdf), traffic-sample-template.csv (csv)

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@clearcredit.io>
To: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Lin <sara@clearcredit.io>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 13:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick demo recap + hosted evaluation asks

Thanks, Kim — appreciate the follow-up and clear plan. Hosted sounds like the right place to start for speed. Answers below:

- Confirming: Hosted pilot accepted for initial eval. We’ll reassess after the pilot for Dedicated if sustained QPS requires it.
- Traffic profile (pilot window): peak 40 RPS total, typical 6–10 concurrent workers during business hours. Production projections (for later) could be 250–300 RPS.
- Routes: primarily /v1/chat (~70% of calls) and a small number of /v1/embeddings (for search re-ranking). For the pilot please set per-route target: chat 30 RPS, embeddings 10 RPS.
- Prompt/response tokens: average prompt ~180 tokens; average response ~220 tokens. Estimated token burn per request ~400 tokens.
- Data: Pilot includes customer PII; retention requirement — do not store raw inputs longer than 7 days; we need to confirm log redaction for sensitive fields.

Two asks: 1) Can you provision the sandbox credentials to rajiv@clearcredit.io and sara@clearcredit.io? 2) We’ve attached a CSV with simulated hourly traffic for the pilot — can you review and confirm those ratecaps are reasonable?

I’m happy to take the follow-up on Thursday — I’ll bring our engineering lead.

— Rajiv
VP of Engineering, ClearCredit

Attachments: clearcredit-traffic-sample.csv (csv)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 29 May 2027 14:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Quick demo recap + hosted evaluation asks

Forwarding Rajiv’s answers and the traffic sample — quick internal notes for pilot config: 

- We can provision sandbox keys for rajiv@clearcredit.io and sara@clearcredit.io. Default trial allocation: 200k tokens; we can increase on request.
- Per-route caps: set chat to 30 RPS and embeddings to 12 RPS to give a small buffer. We should also put in a 60 concurrency ceiling for chat to avoid burst head-of-line effects.
- Data retention: Hosted supports configurable retention windows and log redaction policies. Ops needs to confirm retention policy is enforced for that tenant (set to 7 days) and that audit logs preserve masked values only. I’ll open a follow-up with Security to confirm.
- Suggestions for model and runtime config: use redwood-1.2-small quantized profile for pilot (lower cost, similar quality for your token lengths), enable prefix KV caching for the common prompt fragments you mentioned, and keep streaming enabled for latency-sensitive calls.

Attaching the lightweight quickstart playbook excerpt I referenced.

> (See original message)

— Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-playbook.pdf (pdf)

From: Kim Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@clearcredit.io>, Sara Lin <sara@clearcredit.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Hosted sandbox credentials + next steps (pilot kickoff)

Hi Rajiv / Sara — thanks for the quick turn. We’ve provisioned the hosted sandbox and pushed the following to rajiv@clearcredit.io and sara@clearcredit.io:

- Sandbox endpoints: https://sandbox.redwood-inference.com/clearcredit
- API keys: sent in a separate secure email (please advise if you want them rotated to a vault integration we can configure)
- Token allocation: 350,000 trial tokens (increased based on your sample traffic)
- Ratecaps applied: chat 30 RPS (burst headroom), embeddings 12 RPS, concurrency ceiling 60 for chat; per-key daily quota 1.2M tokens (pilot gating)
- Retention: set tenant-level retention to 7 days, log redaction enabled for PII fields — Security will follow up with confirmation and a snapshot of masked-audit logs.

Next steps:
1) Please run any preflight tests against the sandbox endpoints and share results (latency, error rate).
2) Security will send the retention/audit confirmation; Procurement will loop in if EULA/signature is needed.
3) Let’s meet Thursday 10:00 AM PT to review initial telemetry and confirm whether we should increase allocations. I’ve added a calendar invite — accept if that works.

If you want additional capacity (or want to trial Dedicated capacity in parallel), we can spin up a Dedicated sizing estimate once we see production load shapes.

Thanks again — we’ll be standing by to help with traffic replay or assist your engineers in integrating the SDKs.

— Kim Park
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
